Shipment Tracking System
 A web-based shipment tracking and logistics management platform designed to streamline package delivery and monitoring. The
system enables users to register shipments, track real-time delivery status, view shipment history, and receive timely updates
throughout the delivery lifecycle. It provides role-based access for administrators and customers, ensuring efficient package
management, transparent tracking, and improved operational efficiency through a secure and user-friendly interface.
MediGuard AI (Team Project)
Developed MediGuard AI, a full-stack Patient Health Record (PHR) platform using React, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, MongoDB, and
Firebase. Integrated Groq Llama for AI-powered prescription OCR, implemented secure consent management with digital
signatures, developed AI-based drug interaction checks, and optimized data access through cloud storage with offline IndexedDB
caching. 
Habit Tracking System 
A full-stack MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js) web application designed to help users build and maintain positive
habits 
through structured tracking and goal setting. The platform enables users to create and manage habits, track daily progress, set
personalized goals, and monitor consistency over time—providing a seamless and motivating experience for improving productivity 
and lifestyle.
